description: This PHP file defines functions related to generating JavaScript variables for email template fields and dropdowns in the SuiteCRM system. It loads various beans, constructs collections of field definitions, and encodes them into JSON for client-side use.

methods.name: generateFieldDefsJS2
methods.description: Generates a JavaScript variable containing field definitions for various modules, filtering out certain field types and preparing labels.

methods.name: genDropDownJS2
methods.description: Generates an HTML dropdown with module options for use in email template configurations.
